new_value: {"notes":"Completed GET /config validation and closed the bounded-serialization gaps from the prior audit. The encoder now length-bounds the fixed provider-owned name field and rejects non-NUL names and invalid role enums instead of overreading or silently emitting leaf. Added an isolated real-resource QEMU test covering exact /config path, four-field LCI CBOR schema, content-format 60, bounded output, one-call snapshot consistency, public-read/no-OSCORE policy, missing-provider 4.04, provider/encoding 5.00, invalid snapshots, and undersized buffers. Validation: Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build and 3/3 tests passed; clang-format dry-run and git diff --check passed. Shared dirty CoAP CMake/Kconfig were preserved."}
